audit.why: 53.27% over 5521 games with Renekton owning every row to first item; 6/10 difficulty is fair because the whole lane hinges on landing W before Q3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own prose: Levels 4-5 and First item said Skill, 2+ items said Renekton.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Renekton for rows 0-5 and Skill at 2+ items. whys[3] literally says 'He has no power spike between 4-5 and you do'; whys[5] says you still all-in cleanly through his first item; whys[6] says Kraken and Wit's End eat your R buffer.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 5 to Renekton, row 6 to Skill, all as matched pairs, with phases[6].why restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 'early' field invented a passive called 'Spirit of Defiance' that shields him, and claimed his Q dashes at level 1. Nothing states the shield/anti-shield interaction that actually decides the trade.
audit.why: Yone's passive is Way of the Hunter (every second attack deals magic damage, extra crit chance) — no shield. The shield is Spirit Cleave (W), 14s and scaling with attack speed. Mortal Steel only dashes at 2 stacks of Gathering Storm, so there is no level-1 Q dash. Renekton's empowered W destroys damage shields on the target — it deletes the Spirit Cleave shield and stuns 1.5s in the same cast.
audit.corrected: Name Spirit Cleave as the shield source and state that empowered W destroys it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound is the tracked cooldown across the whole page but its duration values are never given.
audit.why: 22/19/16/13/10 seconds — at rank 1 that is a 22s window where he has no escape after it resolves.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Kraken and Wit's End eat your Dominus buffer. Yone carry threat 9/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: At level 1 Yone actually wins a prolonged auto-trade because his Q dash lets him sidestep your hitbox and his passive Spirit of Defiance gives him a small shield — farm safely, set up Fury, and do not flash-trade. The moment you hit level 2 the matchup flips: E-in through Yone, immediately spend your banked Fury on empowered W. The 1.5-second stun cancels his Q3 return strike — the single hit that deals the bulk of his Q damage — so you absorb almost nothing while he eats your Q-heal on top of the stun. If he starts E he can soul-rewind out, but that burns his escape on a trade where he is already losing health, which is a fine trade for you. By level 3, with armor-shred on your empowered E return dash, every exchange chips his health bar faster than his Spirit shield regenerates it; keep the wave on your side of the river so he cannot E-escape into fog.
edits.after: At level 1 Yone actually wins a prolonged auto-trade because Way of the Hunter adds magic damage on every second attack and Spirit Cleave (W) shields him — farm safely, set up Fury, and do not flash-trade. The moment you hit level 2 the matchup flips: E-in through Yone, immediately spend your banked Fury on empowered W. The 1.5-second stun cancels his Q3 return strike — the single hit that deals the bulk of his Q damage — and empowered W destroys that Spirit Cleave shield outright, so he eats your Q-heal on top of the stun. If he starts E he can soul-rewind out, but that burns his escape on a trade where he is already losing health. By level 3, with armor-shred on your empowered E return dash, every exchange chips his health faster than the shield comes back; keep the wave on your side of the river so he cannot E-escape into fog.

edits.before: Full kit with empowered E armor shred means every trade chips faster than his Spirit shield recovers; keep the wave slow-pushing so he must CS under your engage threat.
edits.after: Full kit with empowered E armor shred means every trade chips faster than Spirit Cleave shields him back; keep the wave slow-pushing so he must CS in your engage range.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Burst him there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Soul Unbound leaves his body behind and snaps him back — burst him on the return.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — his snap-back is where you burst him.

edits.before: Track Yone's Soul Unbound: He snaps back when it ends. Burst him there. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave (W) shields him every 14s — your empowered W destroys that shield and stuns for 1.5s.

notes: 'Spirit of Defiance' was a fabricated passive name attached to a shield Yone's passive does not grant — killed, and the shield correctly attributed to Spirit Cleave. The level-1 'Q dash' claim also contradicted this matchup's own whys[0]; Mortal Steel only dashes at 2 stacks. Chart edits are one atomic group of three matched pairs aligning both layers with the packet chart.
